metadata.description: Aircraft that appear in the ADS-B data. Civil operators, registrations and call signs are fictional; government agencies and military units are real organisations with invented tail numbers. ICAO 24-bit addresses are in the United States civil (a.....) or military (ae....) ranges and are not derived from the registrations.
metadata.joins: icao24 joins ADS-B (icao24); home_base joins airfields[].airfield_id; parking_position_id joins parking_positions[].position_id.
metadata.note_on_unmanned: Only aircraft that carry a transponder are listed. Small unmanned aircraft are in drone_operators.json.
metadata.callsign_note: callsign is what the transponder sends (eight characters at most); callsign_voice is the radio call sign where it is longer
